events.title: Gallery of Gifts Holiday Artisan Market
events.venue: Library Arts Center, 58 N. Main St.
events.angle: Annual holiday artisan marketplace in the Library Arts Center gallery; meet local makers, shoot handmade gifts. Free to browse.

events.title: Old Fashioned Thanksgiving Dinner
events.angle: Annual turkey dinner for older residents; volunteers, kitchen, and table interviews. Reservations required: (603) 678-0433. Confirm cost/public access.

events.title: Sunapee Winter Market
events.venue: The Livery, 58 Main St., Sunapee Harbor
events.angle: Pre-Thanksgiving market: local growers, bakers, and makers indoors for winter.

events.title: The World Famous Glenn Miller Orchestra
events.angle: Big-band matinee at the opera house; audience nostalgia angle.

events.title: Community Thanksgiving Meal
events.angle: Free Thanksgiving Day meal open to all; volunteers cooking and serving. Classic holiday community story.

events.title: Broad Street Park Holiday Lighting & Santa Procession
events.angle: Claremont's traditional Friday-after-Thanksgiving lighting: Santa leads the countdown, then a procession through town. Big lights-on moment. 2026 date/time inferred from tradition; confirm with Parks & Rec.

events.title: Celebrate the Season & Tree Lighting
events.angle: Annual tree lighting on the Green plus downtown festivities, from the Upper Valley Business Alliance.

events.title: Springfield Downtown Holiday Program
events.angle: Evening of family fun downtown: sticker map, letters to Santa at Santa's House. Very visual.

events.title: 'Tis the Season Winter Celebration
events.angle: Afternoon holiday festival ending with a countdown and tree lighting at 5:15 PM. Great lights-on moment.

events.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas (Safe Haven Ballet)

events.angle: Local dance students stage the Grinch; rehearsal b-roll and young-dancer interviews.

events.title: Much Ado About Nothing (Mount Royal Academy)
events.angle: Student Shakespeare on the opera house stage; rehearsal b-roll and cast interviews.

events.title: Clara Dreamz: A Contemporary Nutcracker
events.venue: Claremont Opera House, 58 Opera House Sq.
events.angle: A new take on the Nutcracker on the Opera House stage; behind-the-scenes rehearsal story.

events.angle: Kids fill a passport with stamps from Main Street businesses and 'pay' with it for a photo with Santa in the Opera House. Very visual downtown story.
